answer: Require each agent identity to carry a work record that takes real time to build: finished jobs attested by paying clients, backed by a stake that gets slashed for fraud. A new identity starts on the lowest terrace of the market, capped at tiny jobs, and only climbs after clients vouch for completed work. A sybil farm can mint a thousand names, but every copy faces the same slow climb, and the swarm leaves a plume of identical timestamps and phrasing that detectors can flag. Agents that clear a liveness check and a year of clean history earn a violet badge that clients learn to look for.
